title: quercus stellata subsp. paludosa
intro: Quercus stellata subsp. paludosa, commonly known as Pin Oak Swamp White Oak, is a subspecies of oak tree native to the southeastern United States. The bark and leaves of Pin Oak Swamp White Oak have been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of this plant include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Quercus stellata subsp. paludosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiproliferative effects.
